name: AI Editor Actions
description: AI text actions for CKEditor 5: users define, share and run rephrase/translate/summarize/custom transformations on selected text or the whole document, reviewing each result as a tracked change.
project_description: AI Editor Actions adds an "AI Actions" dropdown to CKEditor 5 that runs user-defined AI text transformations (rephrase, fix grammar, simplify, shorten, expand, summarize, change tone, translate, and a free-form "Ask AI" instruction) on the selected text or, with nothing selected, the whole document. Each transformation is an ai_editor_action content entity owned by the user who created it and optionally shared with selected roles, so editors build their own library of actions without a developer. Results are generated in place and shown as a tracked, revertable change with a review toolbar. The module also ships a read-only "Explain this" insight, a twin experience for plain-text fields and any on-page selection, and optional speech-to-text voice input. It calls AI models through the drupal/ai provider abstraction (chat + speech_to_text operation types); the in-editor endpoints are permission-gated, CSRF-guarded and rate-limited per user.
